components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--action, #111111); color: var(--surface, #ffffff); padding: 0 16px; font: 600 15px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ink-hover, #333333); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink-strong, #000000); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--ink-strong, #000000); }

components.name: Default Button

components.name: Text Input

components.css: .ds-week-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line-soft, #e5e5e7); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #1d1d1f); padding: 18px 20px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-week-card:hover { border-color: #a1a1a6; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-week-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink-strong, #000000); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-week-card:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-week-index { color: var(--muted, #6e6e73); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-week-copy { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-week-copy small, .ds-week-copy span { color: var(--muted, #6e6e73); font-size: 12px; } .ds-week-copy strong { color: var(--ink-strong, #000000); font-size: 17px; font-weight: 630; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-week-open { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 620; }

narrative.overview:
Pose Embed should feel like a calm, carefully prepared briefing placed in front of a researcher and advisor. The interface is restrained and direct: one clear question, action, deliverable, or decision leads each work surface, while supporting evidence waits at the next level of hierarchy.

The system is strictly black, white, and neutral gray. Apple-like system typography, generous whitespace, precise dividers, modest rounding, and progressive disclosure keep dense protocol content readable without making it feel ornamental or promotional. Ant Design supplies the interaction primitives; the visual system makes them feel native to this quiet research workspace.
keyCharacteristics: Strict black, white, and neutral gray.
Generous whitespace with precise, low-contrast dividers.
Ant Design primitives with calm, consistent states.
Progressive disclosure for scientific and operational depth.

rules.name: The No Hue Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce semantic or decorative hues; encode meaning with labels, icons, weight, fill, border, and line style.

rules.name: The Brief Before Detail Rule
rules.body: Use the strongest type for the plain-language question or required action, then step down quickly to calm body copy and compact labels.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Keep working surfaces flat and border-defined; reserve shadows for floating overlays, contained authentication surfaces, and subtle hover feedback.

dos: Do surface Next step, Decision needed, Deliverable, and a plain-language summary before technical detail on work pages.
Do keep meaning independent of color through explicit labels, icons, fill, border, and line style.
Do preserve 44px standard controls, visible focus rings, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use whitespace and dividers to organize dense records before adding containers or decoration.
donts: Don't introduce hue, gradients, or decorative accent colors.
Don't turn a research work page into a marketing hero or generic analytics dashboard.
Don't use shadows as the default boundary for cards and sections.
Don't make technical details compete with the primary briefing; place them in supporting sections or disclosure controls.
Don't collapse status distinctions to fill alone.
